Hi Maya / Evan,

Thanks again for signing — delighted to get Sundial Health live. Attached is an initial execution sprint plan embedded into the MAP that covers rollout gating, canary approach, migration windows, and training for clinical operations. Key asks up front: confirm target go-live week (we proposed Feb 8), and share the names for the two infra/ops leads who will join the weekly cadence.

High-level items in the attachment (Sundial_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0: Environment provisioning & access (VPC peering, KMS)
- Weeks 1–2: Integration sprint (data schema, test vectors, ingest)
- Week 3: Canary run (10% traffic, fallback rules, metrics)
- Weeks 4–5: Migration and cutover (phased, rollback plan)
- Weeks 6–8: Training & enablement (train-the-trainer + playbook)

The canary checklist also includes automatic fallback to the 8-bit quantized variant if latency or error rate thresholds are crossed. We've left slack for a 1-week buffer for any SOC/procurement gating.

Next steps I recommend this week:
1) Confirm go-live week and ops contacts.
2) Accept the MAP spreadsheet in HubSpot (I linked it).
3) Kick off a 30-minute alignment call Tuesday (I can do 10–10:30 PT).

If this looks good I'll schedule the recurring Monday 30m Ops cadence and assign owners for each sprint row.

Thanks,

—Logan

Logan —

Quick internal note after skimming the MAP: a couple of suggested clarifications before we send to Maya as a formal MAP:

- Canary thresholds: specify both p95 latency (ms) and error-rate delta over baseline (we should propose p95 < 220ms and error delta < 0.8%).
- Migration cutover: call out the data retention snapshot and the rollback timeline (we recommend a 3-hour window to revert and a full DB snapshot at T-15m).
- Training: split clinical and engineering tracks and ensure we have a train-the-trainer on week 6 plus office hours during weeks 6–8.

I'm adding these into the attached canary-checklist.md and training_schedule_v2.pdf and will upload a tidy MAP v1.1 after Logan confirms go-live week.
